Mumbai Fire: 11 Rescued from Kandivali Commercial Building Blaze

A fire broke out at the Abhirai Hotel, a commercial building on Kandivali Station Road in Mumbai, at approximately 4:14 a.m. on Monday. Firefighters rescued 11 people from the building, with the blaze reportedly reaching the fourth floor. The rescued individuals were brought out via ladders from a lodging house on the second floor. No casualties were reported.
